dataset: team-provided DR_SD binary weld X-ray image collection; researcher reports association with Wang et al. 2025; exact local file identity and crop lineage not independently verified
training_subset_sampling: nested random label-blind sampling from train
attention_definition: CBAM spatial branch only; channel mean/max, 7x7 convolution, sigmoid gate
initialization: paired ImageNet supervised ResNet18 weights; target-domain contrastive training is self-supervised, not fully unsupervised end-to-end
training_budget: fixed batch and optimizer steps; report repeated image exposures, wall time, memory, and attention-branch overhead
cluster_k_policy: known-K binary task; labels are not passed to K-means
clustering_fit_pool: fixed unlabeled calibration split (called cluster-fitting partition in research prose)
primary_contrast: C_s = Delta_s(10%) - Delta_s(100%); positive means attention's relative ARI benefit is larger at 10% than at 100%
secondary_contrast: A_s = mean of Delta_s(10%), Delta_s(50%), Delta_s(100%)
stability_definition: pairwise ARI between test assignments from repeated K-means initializations on the same features and, separately, across training seeds
xml_extension: optional after XML matching, coordinates, taxonomy and consistency audit
